title: Google Calendar Report Builder
reason: We need this skill because Google Calendar workflows degrade when auth, schema, and side-effect handling drift when integrations are run ad hoc. This specific skill turns Google Calendar Report Builder into a deterministic, auth-checked workflow for generates operational and kpi reports from google calendar activity..
implementationGuide: Define the report audience, metric definitions, and freshness threshold for Google Calendar Report Builder, then confirm which Google Calendar entities are in scope.
Validate credential reuse and ensure the query window matches the reporting cadence before any render starts.
Implement generates operational and kpi reports from google calendar activity. with deterministic metric synthesis, template versioning, and publication gating.
Capture metric lineage, freshness timestamps, and template identifiers in the report bundle so the output remains auditable.
Run regression checks that cover stale data, metric drift, and template mismatch before publishing the report.
Publish the report bundle only after freshness and correctness gates pass, along with any interpretive notes required for downstream readers.

humanUseCases: Generate operational reporting from provider data without publishing incorrect or stale metrics.
Standardize reporting outputs so downstream reviews can compare runs consistently.

preflight: Validate the metric definitions, time window, and publication audience before building the report.
Confirm the source data contract and output template version.
execution: Compute metrics deterministically and preserve intermediate query identifiers.
Render the report only after freshness and completeness checks pass.
recovery: Hold publication when metrics are stale, incomplete, or fail reconciliation checks.
Rebuild from the last known good query window after correcting the data issue.
handoff: Return the report bundle, metric lineage, and publication decision.
Call out any missing windows, excluded entities, or operator notes needed to interpret the report.

guardrails.rule: Hold report publication when metrics drift from declared definitions or freshness thresholds.
Preserve query lineage and output template versions for every report build.
Reuse cached intermediate results when they remain inside freshness tolerance.

alertTriggers: schema or contract regressions persist for two consecutive runs
critical posture or rollback events exceed tolerance

authModes.label: OAuth client or delegated session
authModes.validation: Reuse an active delegated session or validate the client credentials with a lightweight identity call.

notes: Prefer existing user or service sessions and confirm tenant/workspace context before writes.
